messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long weekends that Canadians will enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that creates an extended weekend—either because the holiday falls on a weekday or because it’s observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the following Monday was a holiday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Family Day is on Monday, so the preceding weekend is part of the long weekend. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a holiday; the weekend follows immediately. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is on Monday, giving a three‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the following Monday was a holiday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is on Monday, creating a three‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is on Monday, giving a three‑day weekend. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the following Monday was a holiday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas is on Monday, giving a three‑day weekend. |

**Boxing Day (Dec 26)** falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does *not* create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
